name: Turfagon
summary: A mafia game played on a map of your real city, any city in the world, cut into hexagons. Take a block with one tap, or drive through it for real. Put a runner on it, build fronts and stash houses, and it earns while you are away. Rival Families with their own Dons and grudges text you threats, roll up on your blocks, and call you to sit-downs. Climb from Street Rat to Kingpin and hand the Family down to an heir.
